integrity: Exact finite integer and rational chain computations and a self-contained verifying Python program accompany the written proof. Publication priority remains subject to unindexed sources.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the rank-three seven-point Fano binary vector matroid. The geometric lattice is primitive as an abelian sublattice; no integral group-module direct sum is asserted. The complement is irreducible over the rationals but splits as conjugate 3-dimensional irreducibles over the complex numbers. No extension to larger fields or independent verification is asserted.
title: A primitive seven-sphere lattice and exceptional six-dimensional Fano matroid homology
